description: Illustrative synthetic Service Request taxonomy for an educational PoC. It is not a real bank catalogue and carries no legal, regulatory or SLA meaning.

primaryIntents.COMPLAINT: The customer expresses dissatisfaction or a formal grievance.
primaryIntents.INQUIRY: The customer asks for clarification or information.
primaryIntents.ACTION_REQUEST: The customer asks for a service action to be performed.
primaryIntents.INCIDENT_REPORT: The customer reports a malfunction without clearly expressing a formal complaint.

problemDomains.ACCOUNTS: Account access, account details or account status.
problemDomains.DIGITAL_CHANNELS: Mobile app, login, website or online banking malfunction.
problemDomains.SUPPORT_SERVICE: Staff conduct or quality of support.

requestedOutcomes.REFUND: The customer asks for money to be returned.
requestedOutcomes.FIX_PROBLEM: The customer asks for a problem to be fixed.
requestedOutcomes.INVESTIGATE: The customer asks for something to be looked into.
requestedOutcomes.EXPLAIN: The customer asks for an explanation.
requestedOutcomes.PERFORM_ACTION: The customer asks for a specific service action.

serviceRequestTypes.CLAIM: Synthetic formal complaint or dispute record.
serviceRequestTypes.TECHNICAL_REQUEST: Synthetic request to resolve a technical malfunction.
serviceRequestTypes.SERVICE_REQUEST: Synthetic request for a service action.
serviceRequestTypes.UNCLASSIFIED: Abstention: no formal type is proposed and the case needs manual triage.

reasonCodes.description: Complaint or refund request about a payment or charge.
